name: install_bitbucket
title: Install a package directly from Bitbucket

origin.description: Download a Bitbucket repository archive and install it with R CMD INSTALL.
origin.usage: install_bitbucket(repo, ref = "HEAD", subdir = NULL, auth_user = bitbucket_user(), password = bitbucket_password(), host = "api.bitbucket.org/2.0", dependencies = NA, quiet = FALSE, ...)

arguments.name: repo
arguments.text: username/repo, optionally with a package name or ref.

arguments.name: ref
arguments.text: Branch, tag, or commit. The default is HEAD.

arguments.name: auth_user
arguments.text: Bitbucket user. The default is BITBUCKET_USER.

arguments.name: password
arguments.text: Bitbucket password or app password. The default is BITBUCKET_PASSWORD.
Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

origin.details: The archive URL is taken from the Bitbucket source link for the ref. The commit hash is stored as the remote sha.
origin.example: install_bitbucket("djnavarro/lsr", dependencies = FALSE, upgrade = "never", quiet = TRUE, build = FALSE, lib = lib)

translation.description: Download a Bitbucket repository archive and install it with R CMD INSTALL.
translation.usage: install_bitbucket(repo, ref='HEAD', subdir=None, auth_user=None, password=None, host='api.bitbucket.org/2.0', dependencies=NA, quiet=False, lib=None)

arguments.name: auth_user
arguments.text: None unless BITBUCKET_USER is set and the argument is left at its default.
Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

translation.details: The bundle is downloaded with urllib and installed with R CMD INSTALL into lib. A check uses a fresh temporary library and does not write to ~/R/library.
translation.example: install_bitbucket("djnavarro/lsr", dependencies=False, upgrade="never", quiet=True, build=False, lib=lib)
